text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking down the
hallway...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
All that's left to prepare for the new
trainer
orientation is the handouts. That
should be it for
today's work.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I almost forgot to feed Director
Akikawa's
cat! But even if I head to her
office now...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?! Oh, how embarrassing for you
to see me
like this!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
choice_data_list: 理事長室までひとっ走りしますよ！
書類作成、お手伝いしますよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll sprint over to the Chairwoman's office!
I can help you prepare the paperwork.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much! Only if you're really
sure it's
okay, though.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Her cat's been eating a lot lately. The
director has
even been complaining of a
sore neck from
carrying it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So please don't give it too much food!
No matter
how cute it acts!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, now that I think about it... It feels
like just
yesterday I was showing you the
ropes...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And look at you now! You're a truly
splendid
trainer with a trainee of your
own!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please provide the same support to all
the new
trainers in the future!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Tazuna has a lot of
responsibilities
aside from being the
director's secretary.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you worried about me? Hehe... I

appreciate your concern.
choice_data_list: 忙しくし過ぎていませんか……？
choice_data_list_en: Haven't you been keeping yourself a bit too busy...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But I assure you, I'm perfectly fine! I'm
confident
in my physical fitness, and
most importantly...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Being able to help Umamusume and
their trainers
alike brings me more joy
than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's work, of course, but it's also a way of
life for
me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In her smile, I can feel the great amount
of love
Tazuna has for what she does.
